items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: “Wow, its amazing how Art Blakey plays like Yamaguchi.”

ctx.x: You went and got…that was the first time you had a passport?

I think so. Then I wound up going to Japan twice before I even went to Europe. It was very interesting. I went again later on in 1966 with a drum tour. It was Tony Williams, Elvin Jones, Art Blakey, McCoy Tyner, Ben Tucker on bass, Wayne Shorter and myself. We played for about a week and Tony Williams got busted. We were all informed by George Wein about no narcotics. I never had a problem like that so it didn’t matter for me. But, no narcotics of any kind. If you were walking in crowds of people, put your hands…
Well, did Tony get out and go back with you. Did he have to stay in Japan?
